_l9_meta.note: Manus Custom MCP connector. The direct-provider connector (graphiti-memory over a provider URL) was retired at realignment stage C7/C8: Cursor-Governance no longer publishes a provider transport to any surface. The canonical memory control plane (l9-graphite-memory) is a stdio server owned by the memory package; Manus, a remote surface, has no sanctioned transport to it until the memory package publishes one. No connector is declared here on purpose — an entry naming a transport memory did not authorize would be a claim memory never made.
